notes: Face size measured from the bottom of the chin to the top of the skull, excluding hair (70–80% of the photo).
Plain white background with no border.
Bare head, no hats or decorative objects; neutral expression, mouth closed, eyes open.
Glasses are optional; if worn, frames must be thin, must not hide the eyes, lenses must not be tinted, and there must be no reflections.
Colour photo strongly recommended; recent photo.
Official size is any width 35–40 mm and height 45–50 mm; 35 × 45 mm is used here.
Face length from chin to crown of head 25–35 mm.
Taken against a light background; matt finish; two identical copies less than six months old.
Full face, no hat, eyes wide open, neutral expression, mouth closed.
If glasses are worn, the eyes must be visible.
Values from the Nigeria Immigration Service passport portal photo guidelines (image compliance page) for the online application photo.
Head (top of hair to bottom of chin) 25–35 mm, stated as 50%–69% of image height.
Eye line 56%–69% of image height from the bottom, converted to mm on a 50.8 mm photo.
Digital photo at least 600 × 600 pixels and at least 54 KB; compression ratio no more than 20:1; 24-bit colour.
Plain white or off-white background without shadows; taken within the last 6 months.
Eyeglasses are no longer allowed; no hats or head coverings except for religious or medical reasons.
Many printed-photo guides cite 35 × 45 mm for Nigerian passports; the official portal guidance states 2 × 2 in.
It is acceptable if an infant's eyes are not entirely open.
No other person may appear in the photo.
From the Department of Home Affairs 'Passport & ID Photograph Specifications' leaflet.
Two identical colour photos, not more than one month old.
Light grey or plain cream-coloured background; uniform lighting, no shadows, flash reflections or red-eye.
Glasses: eyes must be clearly visible with no flash reflection; no dark-tinted lenses or heavy frames.
Head coverings only for religious reasons, with the face from bottom of chin to top of forehead and both edges visible.
Neutral expression, mouth closed; printed professionally on high-quality photo paper.
